boundary_checks.required_boundary: Fixed-source strong limit is identifiable projection. Operator-norm convergence equivalent to closed actual range (converse uses nontrivial filter); nonclosed source-filter error norm equals one at every positive parameter.
boundary_checks.status: preserved in final reviewed statements and companion explanations; bounded source comparison passed

boundary_checks.gate: Closed actual range versus dense range
boundary_checks.required_boundary: Bounded canonical recovery requires complete/closed actual range. Density supplies approximation, not a bounded inverse or attainment.
boundary_checks.status: preserved in final reviewed statements and companion explanations; bounded source comparison passed

boundary_checks.gate: Complete coordinate representation versus lossy split compression
boundary_checks.required_boundary: Resolution requires sa=I_X and projector-compatible kernels. Lossy compression instead has CR=I_Z and hidden-return defect CS(I-RC)TR. Algebraic coordinate regrouping retaining all entries cannot be identified with deletion/aggregation.
boundary_checks.status: preserved in final reviewed statements and companion explanations; bounded source comparison passed

boundary_checks.required_boundary: Hidden finite dimension d yields whole-map prepared tests through d+1. Observation horizon dim ker O yields bounded word length; finite test enumeration additionally needs finite alphabet; coordinate states form actual observation-map range.
boundary_checks.status: preserved in final reviewed statements and companion explanations; bounded source comparison passed

boundary_checks.required_boundary: No source cap appears in acceptance; parameter existence requires eta>0, tau>1 and delta||p||<(tau-1)eta with truth premises. Existing accepted families can converge under weaker assumed acceptance and vanishing errors.
boundary_checks.status: preserved in final reviewed statements and companion explanations; bounded source comparison passed

boundary_checks.gate: Model normal residual versus true normal residual
boundary_checks.required_boundary: Same parameter/source; external whole-operator bound. Difference identity and norm envelope allow arbitrary real parameter; inverse correction requires positive parameter. A small model residual does not cancel model uncertainty.
boundary_checks.status: full raw module and final visual section36/SR54 compared; passed
